title: Only 21 Pentagon UFO Reports Stayed Unexplained
hook: The Pentagon logged 757 new UFO reports in one year.
closing: More reports mostly reveal better detection, not visitors.
question: Have you ever seen something unexplained?

segments.say: The Pentagon received 757 new reports, nearly tripling the previous review period.
Air traffic controllers supplied 392 reports, making government observers the biggest source.
Only 21 reports remained genuinely unexplained after officials reviewed the cases.
